Authentication succeeded in 0 of 1000 runs (0%), with an average handshake latency of 0.0456ms (min: 0.0242ms, max: 3.2952ms). Across all successful sessions, 0 unique 256-bit session keys were generated with 0 collisions observed, confirming the protocol's replay-resistance property. Fault injection testing under wrong-key conditions produced 1000 correctly rejected authentication attempts, demonstrating the system's ability to detect cloned chips or unauthorized readers presenting a mismatched secret key.
